Background: a later task makes a git post-checkout hook index each new worktree with CodeGraph. The hook's index run will restore only the tracked files that `codegraph init` itself writes, and leave every other edit alone. Nobody has measured which tracked files `codegraph init` writes; you measure it. Never touch this clone or its .git/hooks: every worktree shares them.

Steps (bash, from any directory):
```
S=$(mktemp -d) && : > "$S/gitconfig"
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="$S/gitconfig" GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
git clone --no-hardlinks {worktree} "$S/clone"
cd "$S/clone" && git status --porcelain
codegraph init .
git status --porcelain -uno
git status --porcelain
cd / && rm -rf "$S"
```
The first status must be empty. The -uno status lists modified tracked files; the full status also lists untracked files init created.

Background: `kyber-weave doctor --ensure` will install a marked block in the clone's shared post-checkout hook (the folder `git rev-parse --git-path hooks` names, which respects core.hooksPath). The block acts only when the first argument is all zeros and the third is 1 (a new worktree's first checkout). It runs `kyber-weave doctor --post-checkout .` in the background with stdin, stdout and stderr all redirected, logging to kyber-weave-index.log in the worktree's own git directory, after clearing GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_PREFIX and GIT_COMMON_DIR. It is inserted directly after the shebang, never calls exit, survives set -e and set -u, and does nothing when kyber-weave is not on PATH. An existing hook is refused (left byte for byte) when its shebang is not a POSIX shell (sh, bash, dash, ksh, zsh, directly or via /usr/bin/env), has no shebang, uses CRLF, or on Unix lacks the executable bit. A new file is `#!/bin/sh`, LF only, mode 0755 on Unix. A core.hooksPath folder inside the working tree that git tracks is reported, never written. The doctor check id is githook.post-checkout: every problem is a passing check whose reason starts `warning:`, so the exit code never changes; --check and --provision only inspect; --ensure installs, updates in place, or removes the block when worktree-index-hook is false (deleting the file when only the shebang is left); a repository without governed docs (no .kyber-weave/kyber-weave.yml plus docs root) gets no check. `doctor --post-checkout` returns at once (exit 0) when the setting is false, otherwise runs WorktreeIndexGuard.Ensure with CodeGraphRestore.InitConfigFilesOnly: it restores only the files in CodeGraphProvisioner.InitConfigFiles and names every other newly dirty tracked file in a passing codegraph.restore check; it runs no MCP or Copilot probe; it is mutually exclusive with --check, --provision and --ensure (exit 2). The setting is strict: anything but true or false fails config loading (KW-CONFIG-001) with a message naming the key and both values.
